turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:
dress changes can only be reviewed if the order hasn’t been fulfilled yet, and because orders are processed fast, it may no longer be possible. Send your order number or the checkout email and I’ll check it for you.

Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?

No — once an order is placed, it can’t be canceled, so there isn’t a cancellation window. Orders move into processing right away, which is why we’re not able to stop or modify them after checkout.
